visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white engraved illustration depicting a tense scene in a dense forest. A group of people, including men in colonial-era European clothing and several Indigenous men, are gathered. One Indigenous man in the foreground is in the act of throwing a tomahawk toward a woman who is cowering with her hands to her head. Another man in colonial attire stands nearby, looking on.
visualDescription.visualObjectsEn: Trees, forest floor with branches, tomahawk in mid-air, colonial-style coats, hats, breeches, Indigenous-style clothing, loincloths, feathers, belts, pouches.
visualDescription.recognizableCharactersOrPeopleEn: A woman with long hair, a man in colonial attire standing to the left, a man in colonial attire partially obscured in the center, and several Indigenous men, one of whom is throwing a weapon.
visualDescription.uncertaintyNotes: The specific identities of the individuals are not explicitly stated in the image itself, though the style suggests a 19th-century historical or literary illustration. The exact nature of the interaction is inferred from the action of the weapon in flight.
